cmass intentions this weekend annual mass of remembrance st. colmcille’s church the early irish saints partnership of parishes swords, river valley , brackenstown & donabate 1st of november – feast of all saints these envelopes are now available at the back of the church. . the completed envelopes can be returned to the sacristy or the parish office. during the month of november your list of the dead will remain on the altar and every first friday of every month your loved ones will be remembered in our daily mass. november altar list of the dead for parishioners who have died during the past year will take place on wed 18th november at 7.30pm . families of those who have passed away will receive an invitation in the coming weeks. all parishioners are welcome to join us for this special mass, as we come together in prayer and remember our loved ones who have passed away. sat 6.30pm : martin mctiernan, john & brendan clarke siobhan murray sun 11.30am : thomas broderick(a), tony mills (3a) & the mills family, clare venon, sinead heslin, cathy & leonardo bassie. intentions for next week mon 10.00am : patricia o’ reilly(a), the cully family, nigel barker(rd), christopher, ann & christopher jr. farren, brian morgan & family. tues 10.00am: wed 10.00am: thurs 10.00am: communion service fri 10.00am : altar list of the dead adoration takes place every thursday night in st. colmcille's church 7.00pm - 8.00pm. all are welcome spend a quiet moment in the presence of the lord. eucharistic adoration is a time for prayer, reflection and peace. for more information

vocational society of st. joseph monthly meeting invitation when: last wednesday of every month, following 10:00am mass venue: the sacristy, st. cronan’s church (early irish saints parish partnership) about us: the society of st. joseph supports and promotes priestly and religious vocations within our parish partnership. member roles: pray & support: pray regularly for vocations and offer encouragement to those discerning. community outreach: help raise awareness and organize local parish events. fellowship: meet monthly for prayer, reflection, and project planning. all are welcome! contact for details: maurice o’connor (branch secretary)

st. finian’s cc swords are hosting a future pathways careers fair on wednesday 4th november 2026 from 10am-2pm in the school sports hall. we are delighted to invite locals to our school to meet over 50 exhibitors from irish universities, colleges of further education, apprenticeships, local industry and businesses in the community. no registration required, if you would like more information
